summary: Closed out the multi-voter question with a receipt-backed bounded negative on its last open point. Receipt 4e9eaa72cf594018b8414a8d8efb7cb3 resolves all three durability comparisons as holding: two seconds after healing, the isolated node and the majority-side leader each still held their own acknowledged entry in their own log store, neither had applied an entry absent from its own log (applied_without_log false on both sides, evaluated event index 27), and the flag-off control's isolated side never acknowledged anything (index 29). So no lost acknowledged entry or applied-without-log divergence was produced in this schedule and window, and none is claimed; the truncation mechanism is not excluded, so the registered gap stays open on exactly that point. The question's whole account remains violated with defect_claim asserted on four complete comparisons with controls — configuration loss (witness 15, control 18), minority election (witness 22, control 25), single-side acknowledgement (witness 27, control 29) and concurrent two-sided acknowledgement (witness 27, control 29) — with the durability bounds, the schedule dependence explained by requestVote's existing-leader guard, the bounded windows and the un-explored scenario variants all retained as counterevidence and limitations, a Fact knowledge entry promoted for the negative, and joint history covering the five complete executions of the same scenario.
